messages:
alex: FYI caught a small late ingestion blip in eu-west last night. ~1.8k events in two 8-12m pockets. looks like late uploader retries. wondering if we should do a focused reprocess vs full-day backfill
maria: can we target just the affected windows? full backfills chew Dedicated slots and push other jobs back.
jon: agreed. prefer windowed reprocesses. question: routing policy? put these on Dedicated by default or route to Shared with rate caps?
tina: if tenant doesn't have reserved Dedicated, Dedicated will fail. we should add a policy precedence: tenant_reserved -> tenant_burst_allowed -> shared_limited. document that in console UX.
leo: cost-wise: a mini-window reprocess last month cost ~€3.2 per window on Shared, €0.9 on Dedicated (because of packing). but Dedicated availability is the gating factor.
ops-bot: JOB_CREATED: reprocess-dryrun-778 (queued) 
alex: I'm going to run a dry-run sample first (1% of keys) to estimate delta and cost. CLI I used:
```
ri reprocess start \
  --region=eu-west \
  --window=2026-03-20T21:52Z/2026-03-20T22:00Z \
  --sample 0.01 \
  --prefer deds \
  --dry-run
```
jon: nice. please post the dry-run summary in the console panel so ops can accept the recompute. the panel should show: sample_delta, projected_full_delta, estimated_token_cost, preferred_pool, fallback_policy.
maria: UX suggestion: one-click "accept recompute" when projected_full_delta < 0.02% and cost < threshold. otherwise require manual approval + a short justification field.
tina: we need a governance switch: allow-tenant-burst. default=false for mid-market. sales can toggle for enterprise. also put a per-tenant monthly burst spend cap.
leo: routing detail: fallback shared must enforce throttle: shared:rate(80r/s) and concurrency cap 3 per-tenant. otherwise noisy reprocesses can collide.
jon: add a safety pre-check step: if projected_full_delta > 0.5% fail the auto-apply path and create a review ticket with diffs attached.
ops-bot: SUGGESTION: create incident if recompute_delta > 0.5% for any top-level metric OR if job fails >3 times in a row.
alex: about post-run verification: we should snapshot pre-run aggregates and compare post-run. attach both snapshots to the run record and surface a small diff heatmap in console.
maria: good. also include a roll-forward/roll-back decision tree in run metadata. usually we roll-forward; roll-back is messy. but if delta negative/positive beyond thresholds, require engineering sign-off.
leo: any objections to adding a small cost estimator in the dry-run summary that factors model size, avg tokens, and batching hints? we can reuse the optimizer's estimator.
jon: fine. next actions: (1) add routing policy precedence and fallback throttle + config knobs (2) console: dry-run summary + accept button + justification + diff heatmap (3) enforce per-tenant burst opt-in and spend cap (4) ops-bot alert rule for >0.5% delta (5) run tonight's dry-run and post results here
tina: I'll draft the console wire for the panel and include the accept flows (auto-apply thresholds + manual review path).
alex: scheduling dry-run at 23:15 UTC. tagging @eng-sre in case there's any alert churn. :bell:
ops-bot: REMINDER: oncall (eng-sre) notified for job reprocess-dryrun-778 at 23:15 UTC
leo: please capture CPU/GPU slot usage and slot acquisition latency so we can tune max-concurrency defaults.
maria: will record cost and slot metrics. thanks team.
